RCB retains 20 players, releases 6; has ₹14.15 crore available for IPL 2027 auction
 Royal Challengers Bengaluru retained 20 players and released six ahead of the IPL 2027 auction
 Updated - November 18, 2026 03:22 pm IST 
 The Hindu Bureau READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 Royal Challengers Bengaluru‘s players celebrate with the tournament trophy during the presentation ceremony after winning the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 title.
 | Photo Credit: PTI
 All 10 IPL franchises have finalised their retained and released player lists ahead of the IPL 2027 mini auction. With the retention process complete, the franchises have a combined purse of ₹297.95 crore and 66 vacant squad slots heading into the auction, scheduled to be held in Goa on December 16, 2026.
 Royal Challengers Bengaluru retained 20 players and released six ahead of the IPL 2027 auction. England batter Jacob Bethell headlines the list of released players, while fast bowlers Mangesh Yadav and Richard Gleeson have also been let go. Bethell, who is set to undergo surgery for a knee injury, will miss England’s tour of South Africa as well as next year’s IPL season.
 Also read | IPL 2027 retention highlights- November 17, 2026 
 Punjab youngsters Vihaan Malhotra and Satvik Deswal have also been released. RCB will head into the IPL 2027 auction with ₹14.15 crore remaining in its purse and five slots to fill, including one overseas spot.
